Owner: estate-c945953fdeb7 / product_execution_next, with root coordinating a questions-only independent content review.

## Learner outcome

Add an original twelve-question SQLite lesson about three-valued predicates, IN/NOT IN, EXISTS/NOT EXISTS, an empty right-hand relation, and explicit policies for missing outer keys. A worked guide and plain executable SQL worksheet let learners predict complete results, inspect actual SQLite observations, and then open the separate course file through the existing learner.

This develops a specific gap beyond the received SQL foundations #22: its full source `bd063f720795e486f7ebfa6abc3c38d5e911e099` covers rows, basic NULL tests, aggregates and joins, without IN/NOT IN/EXISTS. Transactions #84, window functions #213, functional dependencies #222, foreign keys #225, recursive SQL #236, conflict serializability #247 and the existing importer/catalog/reader owners keep their scopes.

Current main is `ec07bf3989132130759e5c00c6cb02eef19709d3`, tree `a839b6877bf2824f134443829d1ce62e1bd79e50`, with 2,933 complete leaves and no governing AGENTS file. The exact three proposed paths are absent. Bounded topic checks across all 254 earlier issue/PR bodies and the current updated inventory through #255 found no matching membership/absence lesson. This is proposed original teaching content, not an observed user request or a universal owner census.

## Exact new-file fence

- `courses/sql-null-membership.json`: native `recallweave-deck/1` course.
- `courses/sql-null-membership.md`: worked guide, stated outcomes and use instructions.
- `courses/sql-null-membership.sql`: original fictional setup and twelve numbered plain SQL queries.
- Evidence only under `docs/receiving/sql-null-membership-c945953fdeb7/**`.

No new worksheet CLI, simulator, explorer, builder or validator framework. No shared README, catalog, offline pack, learner, importer, model, review/notes, existing course, dependency or workflow edit.

## Authority, runtime and usable handoff

The complete questions, options, fixture and exact SQL will be sealed without answers/explanations before root derives independent choices and complete results. No new course, answer key or worksheet has been executed. Private drafting and the subsequent freeze will be dated explicitly.

Dialect: **SQLite**, using the primary [expression documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_expr.html), especially the IN/NOT IN matrix, EXISTS and boolean context. The proposed native route is the already available Python 3.12.14 runtime with SQLite 3.53.1; a prior read-only capability observation pins its built-in engine to executable SHA256 `fa67443527ed9647f760d807e2a38f26340757123e643c4639cf273ed15d5ea7`. Fresh resource/runtime admission will precede any query. Original worksheet output and unchanged native-format parser acceptance will be stated separately.

A new physical course file will be selected through **Bring your own lesson** in the existing independently received direct-file learner `app/demo.html` (Git `ef7bc3e27e7f161d917ced6a457fad8822802f3f`) at the owned `RecallWeaveEditDistance-c945953fdeb7` installation. The existing START-HERE → learner route and all nineteen installed files remain unchanged. The new course is not added to that installation or its catalog. One ordinary learner session and a physical study-notes handoff will qualify the new content use without reopening the completed importer/reader/mathematics acceptance campaigns. Strict UTF-8 picker and combined-output work remains with #7/#181/#109/#159.

All five current tracked workflow bodies were read fully and their identities rechecked: main push and/or PR events only, no issue/comment subscriber. The later observed managed Pages Actions hazard remains controlling for refs. This issue reserves only the bounded source/receiving scope; it authorizes no ref, PR, main, Pages/settings, workflow, deployment or Actions mutation.

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-handout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4, inherited project pin
      - name: Require cached Node 22 and an installed system browser
        id: native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION=
          for HANDOUT_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION="${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR##*/}"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required; no runtime will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'node=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          HANDOUT_BROWSER=
          for HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              HANDOUT_BROWSER="$(command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required; no browser will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'browser=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" --version
          command -v python3
          if command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdftotext -v; else echo "pdftotext unavailable; PDF artifacts require separate direct inspection."; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4, inherited project pin
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.native.outputs.node }}
      - name: Install and identify the standard CJK print font
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk
          dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' fonts-noto-cjk
          command -v fc-match
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY="$(fc-match --format='%{family}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE="$(fc-match --format='%{file}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          printf 'Japanese font family: %s\nJapanese font file: %s\n' "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          [[ "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" == *"Noto Sans CJK JP"* ]]
          [[ -f "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}" ]]
          dpkg-query -S -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          sha256sum -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
      - name: Receive actual studio, file selection, separate downloads and print artifacts
        run: node tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.native.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/course-handout-receiving"
      - name: Verify the direct-open teacher page matches its modular sources
        run: python3 tools/make_handout.py --check
      - name: Preserve bounded original browser and print artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4, verified from the official tag
        with:
          name: course-handout-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/course-handout-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6
